title: Attention-space Contrastive Guidance for Efficient Hallucination Mitigation in LVLMs
abstract: arXiv:2601.13707v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Hallucinations in large vision--language models (LVLMs) often arise when language priors dominate over visual evidence, leading to object misidentification and visually inconsistent descriptions. We address this problem by framing hallucination mitigation as contrastive guidance that steers generation toward visually grounded and semantically faithful text. We propose Attention-space Contrastive Guidance (ACG), a training-free, single-pass method that operates directly in self-attention layers, where hallucination-inducing cross-modal biases emerge. ACG constructs both image-conditioned and approximate text-only attention paths within a single forward pass, enabling efficient guidance before errors accumulate at the output layer. translated_title: 注意力空间对比引导：面向大型视觉-语言模型的高效幻觉缓解方法
translated_abstract: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）中的幻觉通常在语言先验压制视觉证据时产生，导致物体误识别和与视觉不符的描述。我们将幻觉缓解问题构建为一种对比引导，将生成过程引导向视觉上有依据且语义上忠实于图像的文本。我们提出了注意力空间对比引导（ACG），这是一种无需训练、仅需单次前向传播的方法，直接在自注意力层中运作，而诱发幻觉的跨模态偏差正是在这些层中出现的。ACG 在单次前向传播中同时构建图像条件注意力路径和近似的纯文本注意力路径，从而能够在错误于输出层累积之前实现高效引导。由于这种基于掩码的替代方法可能引入近似偏差，我们进一步应用轻量级的正交投影来抑制与纯文本路径对齐的成分，从而产生更忠实于视觉的输出。
tldr: 提出注意力空间对比引导（ACG），一种无需训练的单次前向传播方法，通过在自注意力层构建图像条件与纯文本对比注意力路径并结合轻量级正交投影，高效缓解大型视觉-语言模型的幻觉问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Attention-space Contrastive Guidance (ACG), a training-free, single-pass method that mitigates hallucinations in LVLMs by constructing contrastive image-conditioned and text-only attention paths within self-attention layers, combined with a lightweight orthogonal projection.
